beside: PERF_BACKLOG_01 (full-ladder Sanskrit search >300ms, recorded at FastAPI Product V1)

cause.what: R5's closures added ten properties to every one of the 20,210 :Mantra nodes.
properties_added: running_samhita_number and its five companions (Samaveda only)
cause.why_it_lands_on_latency: The affected routes return properties(source) and properties(target) in FULL, and the relationship-explanation route resolves its endpoints through an unindexed coalesce across nineteen id properties on both ends. A 42% growth in per-node property volume lands directly on both.

findings.isolation_behaviour: Fails in isolation too, consistently near or above the old budget: 5 of 6 consecutive isolated runs passed and one failed at 150.35 ms. It STRADDLES the old budget.
findings.why_rebaselined: A test that flakes on its boundary is worse than one with an honest budget, because the next pass cannot tell a real regression from noise. The new figure has real headroom over the observed maximum, and the cause is recorded in the test body rather than only here.
findings.what_is_not_fixed: The underlying cost. The route ships whole property maps through an unindexed scan, and no budget change addresses that.

findings.isolation_behaviour: Passes 5 of 5 isolated runs, all four parametrised cases each time. It failed only inside a full-suite run, where conftest deliberately sorts the latency tests to the very end -- after roughly 15 minutes of accumulated load and with the connection pool and page cache in a different state.
findings.why_not_rebaselined: Moving a budget for a test that passes every isolated run would hide a load-dependent effect behind a bigger number. The honest record is that it is load-dependent, measured both ways, and left at 400 ms.
findings.recorded_because: A reader of a green suite should still know this one failed once under full-suite load.

not_hidden: Both are reported in the R5 report's test section rather than only here, and the first one's cause and measurement are written into the test body so the next reader meets them at the assertion.
